show.description: How to Catch Your Cheating Partner” follows Pawan, a suspicious husband, as he spirals into obsession over his wife Noori and her best friend Mayank. What begins with a single strand of hair soon unravels into a tense web of traps, paranoia, and shocking revelations, blurring the line between truth and delusion. Watch Now!
